Thanks Hannah and Ben — appreciate the quick follow-up. The Wed May 15 15:30–16:10 PST slot works for our team (that's 18:30–19:10 EST). We'll have three folks: myself, Negar Lopez (infra lead), and R&D manager Priya.

A few clarifications to help you prep:
- Average tokens/request: ~380 (prompt 120 / generation 260), but peak prompts can reach 1,000 tokens for longer context sessions
- Concurrency: steady-state ~120 req/s, expected peak bursts up to ~280 req/s for short windows (1–3 minutes) during heavy user events
- Latency target: p50 < 250ms for short responses; willing to accept p95 up to 800ms for long generation requests
- Model: planning to evaluate both 13B and 70B families; prefer guidance on quantized 70B to reduce cost if latency is achievable
- Compliance: we're in SOC2 process, will want to review audit log retention and network isolation options

Please send a calendar invite and pre-call checklist. Also curious if Redwood supports private VPC deployments in their US-east region for Dedicated pools.

Best — Samir
